Uses the CI evidence to explain never-unmounted probe hosts and rearming referenced timers pin the event loop, while interactive TTY already keeps the product alive, and recommends unref.
Provides renderer and rollout checks covering half-cell resets, fixed-width/erase behavior, SGR hygiene, source-backed frame integrity, timer audits, host audits, and exit-drain regression.
